newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Rates seen lower on Portugal 3-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Rates seen lower on Portugal 3-yr bonds.

text.p: The average yield at Tuesday's Treasury auction of 20 billion escudos of three-year bonds (OT) was seen in line with secondary levels and sharply down on the previous sale on November 12, analysts and traders said.
Analysts saw banks bidding between 6.05 and 6.10 percent for the March 1999 paper, compared with the average 6.5999 percent at the last sale. Results are expected around 1100 GMT.
The March 1999 OT closed at 6.07 percent on the secondary market on Monday.
"The banks are going to bid at between 6.05 and 6.10 percent, which is where the major part of demand has been centred on the secondary market," said one fixed-income trader.
Traders said the expected level of bids reflected confidence that another rate cut by the Bank of Portugal was possible before the end of the year.
